questions.question: What does Habakkuk complain about at the start of the book?
options: That the king has gone and made a binding treaty with the whole of Egypt
That the holy temple has been left in ruins and forgotten
That the people stubbornly refuse to keep any of the feasts
That God seems to tolerate violence and injustice without acting
questions.answer: That God seems to tolerate violence and injustice without acting

questions.question: Whom does God say he is raising up, which troubles Habakkuk further?
options: The Egyptians of the great Nile

questions.question: Habakkuk is troubled that God would use a more wicked nation to judge Judah.
O LORD, how long shall I cry for help, and you will not _____?
God is raising up the _____, that bitter and hasty nation.
